title: Transcriptomic analysis provides insights into the AUXIN RESPONSE FACTOR 6-mediated repression of nicotine biosynthesis in tobacco (Nicotiana tabacum L.).
authors: Hu, Mengyang; Zhang, Hongbo; Wang, Bingwu; Song, Zhongbang; Gao, Yulong; Yuan, Cheng; Huang, Changjun; Zhao, Lu; Zhang, Yihan; Wang, Longchang; Zou, Congming; Sui, Xueyi
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组分析研究烟草中ARF6转录因子对烟碱生物合成的抑制机制，属于纯转录组表达分析，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心方向无关。
abstract: NtARF6 overexpression represses nicotine biosynthesis in tobacco. Transcriptome analysis suggests that NtARF6 acts as a regulatory hub that connect different phytohormone signaling pathways to antagonize the jasmonic acid-induced nicotine biosynthesis. Plant specialized metabolic pathways are regulated by a plethora of molecular regulators that form complex networks. In Nicotiana tabacum, nicotine biosynthesis is regulated by transcriptional activators, such as NtMYC2 and the NIC2-locus ERFs. However, the underlying molecular mechanism of the regulatory feedback is largely unknown. Previous research has shown that NbARF1, a nicotine synthesis repressor, reduces nicotine accumulation in N. benthamiana. In this study, we demonstrated that overexpression of NtARF6, an ortholog of NbARF1, was able to reduce pyridine alkaloid accumulation in tobacco. We found that NtARF6 could not directly repress the transcriptional activities of the key nicotine pathway structural gene promoters. Transcriptomic analysis suggested that this NtARF6-induced deactivation of alkaloid biosynthesis might be achieved by the antagonistic effect between jasmonic acid (JA) and other plant hormone signaling pathways, such as ethylene (ETH), salicylic acid (SA), abscisic acid (ABA). The repression of JA biosynthesis is accompanied by the induction of ETH, ABA, and SA signaling and pathogenic infection defensive responses, resulting in counteracting JA-induced metabolic reprogramming and decreasing the expression of nicotine biosynthetic genes in vivo. This study provides transcriptomic evidence for the regulatory mechanism of the NtARF6-mediated repression of alkaloid biosynthesis and indicates that this ARF transcription factor might act as a regulatory hub to connect different hormone signaling pathways in tobacco.
abstract_zh: NtARF6过表达抑制烟草中烟碱的生物合成。转录组分析表明，NtARF6作为一个调控枢纽，连接不同的植物激素信号通路，以拮抗茉莉酸诱导的烟碱生物合成。植物特化代谢途径受众多形成复杂网络的分子调控因子调节。在烟草（Nicotiana tabacum）中，烟碱生物合成受转录激活因子（如NtMYC2和NIC2位点ERFs）调控。然而，调控反馈的潜在分子机制在很大程度上尚不清楚。先前研究表明，烟碱合成抑制因子NbARF1可减少本氏烟（N. benthamiana）中的烟碱积累。在本研究中，我们证明NtARF6（NbARF1的直系同源物）的过表达能够减少烟草中吡啶生物碱的积累。我们发现NtARF6不能直接抑制关键烟碱途径结构基因启动子的转录活性。转录组分析表明，这种NtARF6诱导的生物碱生物合成失活可能通过茉莉酸（JA）与其他植物激素信号通路（如乙烯（ETH）、水杨酸（SA）、脱落酸（ABA））之间的拮抗效应实现。JA生物合成的抑制伴随着ETH、ABA和SA信号传导及病原感染防御反应的诱导，从而抵消JA诱导的代谢重编程，并降低体内烟碱生物合成基因的表达。本研究为NtARF6介导的生物碱生物合成抑制的调控机制提供了转录组证据，并表明该ARF转录因子可能作为连接烟草中不同激素信号通路的调控枢纽。
